title: ValueError While Importing A CSV File (form.submit)
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.1.1; operating system Windows 11 24H2; server region eu-
west-2.

## Steps

How to trigger it:
- Open Lattice and begin importing a CSV file.
- Paste text with a stray character from a spreadsheet.
- Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

No traceback; importing a CSV file normally takes a few seconds.

## Actual

It fails on input with characters that nothing validates. Someone pasted the
value from a spreadsheet, stray characters included, and nothing complained.

## Frequency

Happens twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:90 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:54 in run_import
lattice/ui/form.py:257 in submit
ValueError: invalid date '2026-03-29 02:30'
